You’re not just building business cases. You’re defining how the world’s largest companies put AI to work. As a Business Value Consultant at Lio, you find where AI agents create real value, build the business case a CFO signs, and make our most strategic deals possible in the first place.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

In this role, you will:

 - Partner with Account Executives on our most strategic deals, shape deal strategy, and help close seven-figure opportunities with global enterprises

 - Build CFO-grade business cases and ROI models, and defend them when finance and procurement push back

 - Lead value conversations and workshops with C-level stakeholders, on site and in the room where decisions are made

 - Help executive sponsors and champions sell the case inside their own organization

 - Run Agentic Opportunity Assessments at global enterprises: map processes, analyze spend and data, and identify where AI agents create the most value

 - Shape the AI roadmaps of the world’s largest enterprises: turn your findings into a prioritized agentic transformation plan for procurement and present it to the CFO and CPO

 - Turn what wins deals into benchmarks, templates and frameworks that let every AE sell on value

 - Partner with Sales, Value Engineering, Product and the Founders as the commercial owner of the value case


YOUR PROFILE

You'll thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 2–4 years of experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or in business value consulting

 - Have run workstreams or projects independently, from structuring the problem to presenting the answer to senior clients

 - Are analytically confident: you build financial models and turn them into clear stories

 - Understand procurement, finance or operations processes in large enterprises

 - Communicate convincingly with senior stakeholders, up to the C-level

 - Thrive in complex, high-impact enterprise sales cycles

 


WHY JOIN US?

Join Lio and define how the world’s largest companies use AI in procurement. You’ll sit across from CFOs, build the business cases behind our largest deals, and develop the value methodology our whole Go-To-Market team sells with. The work is fast-paced, high-ownership and customer-facing. If you want your analysis to move real decisions, this is the place. Are you in?

Our client is a large commercial painting contractor based in Staten Island, New York, specializing in large-scale painting projects across apartment complexes, office buildings, data centers, and other commercial properties.

Ideal Candidate

ABOUT HARPER

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage for small businesses. We built our own software for nearly every step, so our people spend their time where trust matters. We use AI to earn that trust.

Our AI can only broker as well as the judgment it learns from. You make expert brokerage judgment teachable, testable, and reusable across Harper.

A thin submission for a contractor with an unusual subcontracting setup gets placed badly. You trace why, write the decision standard that would have caught it, turn the case into an AI evaluation, and build a worked example for the placement team. The next ten accounts like it are handled right, by people and by the system.

At most brokerages, the best judgment lives in a few senior heads and leaves when they do. Here you turn it into the workflows, evaluations, and training the whole operation runs on.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Encode brokerage judgment. Turn complex commercial decisions into workflows, decision standards, playbooks, and escalation rules without flattening the judgment that matters.

 - Define product requirements. Work with product and engineering on which brokerage problems to solve and what the product must understand.

 - Train and evaluate AI. Build realistic cases, grading standards, and failure examples, and turn every material failure into a permanent evaluation.

 - Design brokerage workflows. Define how information, decisions, and handoffs should move, and test whether the workflow produces sound judgment.

 - Own the learning standard. Create the cases and worked examples that make expert judgment teachable, with learning and enablement delivering them.

 - Run the expert feedback loop. Stay close to frontline cases, separate one-offs from patterns, and keep every decision traceable to its source evidence.


WHAT YOU NEED

 - You have substantial commercial, wholesale, or placement brokerage experience across complex small and middle-market accounts.

 - You understand GL, property, workers' comp, commercial auto, umbrella, and specialty coverage well enough to spot the material facts and exceptions.

 - You can turn tacit judgment into precise instructions and reviewable evaluations, and you are curious about AI and its failures.

If you meet most of this, apply.



THE REALITY: READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This job does not sell insurance, own a book, carry a quota, or make final placement decisions. You bring the standard and the evidence; product owns the roadmap and account owners keep the final call. When a familiar habit and the evidence disagree, the evidence wins.

This is not the seat if you want to personally produce and bind accounts, if you would rather keep judgment in your head than in a system, or if you need a remote or hybrid schedule.

It is the seat if defining how an AI-native brokerage should broker sounds like the work you want.




HOW WE HIRE

 1. A 30-minute team call on Zoom.

 2. An office session of about two hours, working a real brokerage case with us.

 3. A super day in the office, showing how you operate in real time.


THE BASICS

 - Pay: $140,000 to $210,000 base. Bonus and equity eligible.

 - Where: On-site, five days a week, in the room with the team. San Francisco at 425 Market Street, or New York at 12 E 49th St.

 - Hours: 5am to 7pm PT, Monday through Friday.

 - License: Commercial insurance licenses as the work requires. Harper pays for the training and the exam.

 - Benefits: Health, dental, and vision. San Francisco adds three meals a day in the office, commuter benefits, and a gym membership.


HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short example of expert judgment you made reusable. Tell us the brokerage problem, why the obvious rule fell short, what you built, and how you knew it worked.

Harper is an equal opportunity employer.

Absorb is launching more products than ever, and we need someone to lead how we take them to market. As Senior Manager, GTM Operations, you'll lead our GTM function: setting the operating model for how launches run, owning cross-functional launch strategy, and building the team and processes to scale it.

You'll work with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to decide how each launch goes to market, and you'll be accountable for the results. Product Marketing owns positioning and messaging; you'll own how launches are planned, governed and delivered. You'll stay close to the most critical launches, but most of your impact will come from the system and the team you build.

You'll thrive here if you've built a GTM operating model before, enjoy turning a busy launch calendar into a repeatable system, and can align senior leaders when plans change.



What you’ll do:

• Set the GTM operating model: Define how Absorb takes products to market: launch tiers and service levels, governance and go/no-go criteria, and the cadence that keeps every team aligned.

• Own cross-functional launch strategy: Work with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success leaders on sequencing, timing and readiness across the launch portfolio, and make the call when a release isn't ready.

• Scale how we launch: Build the processes, tooling and templates that let us ship more launches without overloading our field teams or customers, including bundled releases for smaller launches and limits on field-facing launches.

• Lead and grow the GTM function: Manage and develop the GTM team, including hiring, coaching, goal setting and performance reviews, and shape the team's structure as it grows.

• Own planning, tooling and reporting: Run GTM planning, capacity and OKRs, own the GTM tool stack and build the case for new investments, and report launch status, risks and results to senior leadership.

• Measure and improve: Track launch outcomes such as field readiness, adoption and internal launch ratings, and use them to improve the model, working with Marketing Operations on dashboards and tooling.

• Stay close to the work: Step in directly on the most critical launches when needed.



What you’ll bring:

 - • 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years in-house at a B2B SaaS company in GTM operations, launch strategy or a similar role.
   
   • Established people leadership: 3+ years managing people, including experienced individual contributors, with a track record of building and developing a team.
   
   • Portfolio-level launch leadership: you've owned launch strategy across a portfolio of products, not only individual launches.
   
   • Experience designing a GTM or launch operating model and building scalable launch processes.
   
   • Demonstrated influence with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success leadership, including making and defending hard calls on launch readiness.
   
   • Comfort owning planning and reporting, building business cases for new tools or resources, and using data to set priorities and show results.
   
   • Fluency with AI tools to cut manual work.
   
   • (Bonus) Experience leading a GTM Operations function, customer marketing or product adoption programs, or learning technology or HR tech.

Meeting the needs of teams across Sales, Legal, Engineering, and Operations requires dedicated business partnering across employee relations, performance coaching, leave administration, and organizational design.  - Ability to coach managers across different levels, from front-line supervisors to VPs, on performance management, talent growth, and organizational design.

 - Comfort working cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, and People Operations to manage leave administration, severance, payroll, and equity coordination.

 - Familiarity with HRIS platforms, ideally Rippling, and the adaptability to support varied client groups across corporate and field operations.




COMPENSATION

Jasper is the marketing agents platform, built to help enterprises orchestrate AI agents that execute marketing work at scale. Purpose-built for marketing teams, Jasper enables faster, more consistent execution across campaigns, personalization, localization, and compliance—while maintaining enterprise-grade control and governance.

Jasper is trusted by hundreds of enterprises worldwide, including Prudential, Cushman & Wakefield, and nearly 20% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 2021, Jasper has team members across the U.S. and France.



About The Role

As a Strategic AI Outcomes Manager, you'll partner with Jasper's largest enterprise customers to ensure they achieve measurable business outcomes with generative AI. You'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor, helping executive stakeholders define AI transformation strategies, identify high-value use cases, drive organizational adoption, and realize business value across marketing and other enterprise functions.



This is not a commercial account management role. You will not own renewals, pricing, or contract negotiations. Instead, your success is measured by customer outcomes, executive relationships, AI maturity, and long-term strategic value creation. You'll operate alongside Account Executives, Solutions Architects, Product, Marketing, and Customer Education to help some of the world's most recognizable brands operationalize AI at scale.



This fully remote role reports to the Director, AI Outcomes and is open to candidates located anywhere in the continental US.



What you will do at Jasper

Executive Strategic Partnership

 - Build trusted-advisor relationships with senior marketing, operations, digital transformation, and executive (VP/C-level) leaders across your portfolio.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.



Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.



ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.



We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation joined by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.




WHAT THIS ROLE IS

Deployment Strategy Leads own the people and the quality bar behind ValonOS deployments. You are a specialist in a deployment domain, and you build, coach, and hold accountable a team of 3-10 people. Deployment Strategists across the entire customer journey — from contract signature through go-live through adoption. You are part manager, part deployment operator, part quality control. The team's outcomes are your outcomes. The job is not to manage from a dashboard. You stay close enough to the work to catch problems before they become client-facing, and close enough to your people to know when they need a stretch, a course correction, or to be unblocked.

 


WHY VALON

How many times in your career are you going to get the chance to build and run a team deploying eight-and nine-figure software contracts into one of the most regulated industries on the planet? Not many. That's what we do here.

Valon is the AI-native operating system for mortgage servicing — a $13 trillion industry running on infrastructure built before the iPhone. We did not try to fix it from the outside. We bought our way in: built and operate our own mortgage servicing business managing $110B+ in loans, used that operation to deeply understand every workflow that breaks at scale, and then built the software we wished existed.

The result: a 0% margin business turned 60%+. Our own servicing operation runs at 4x the employee efficiency of the industry. Major enterprise servicers — including Newrez — are now deploying ValonOS across the industry. The contracts we are rolling out are some of the largest and most complex enterprise software deployments anywhere in financial services right now. Deployment Strategy Leads make sure the people running those rollouts get better every quarter, not just busier.

 


WHY MORTGAGE SERVICING IS THE MOST INTERESTING PROBLEM YOU'VE (PROBABLY) NEVER THOUGHT ABOUT

Every monthly payment from a homeowner triggers a chain reaction: money has to move, accounting entries have to balance, escrow has to disburse to the right counties and insurers, and every step has to satisfy regulators across all 50 states — each with its own foreclosure rules, notice timelines, fee restrictions, and licensing regimes. Get any of it wrong and you have created a CFPB headline.

Now do that for millions of loans, with hundreds of legacy vendors, dozens of capital partners, and operators who have been doing it one way for 30 years.

Mortgage servicing has resisted software automation for decades not because the individual problems are unsolvable, but because the abstractions are so hard to model correctly that no one had done it. We did. It took six years. Now we are deploying it across the industry — and your team is on point.

Hanover Park https://hanoverpark.com/ builds AI systems that run financial operations for investment firms. We combine software and fund administration to help fund CFOs adopt AI in the workflows they’re responsible for every day.

We’ve raised $31 million from Emergence Capital, Lux Capital, Susa Ventures, and fund CFOs from Bain Capital, Clearlake, CD&R, and Hellman & Friedman.

Fund administration is our starting point. Our ambition is to build the financial infrastructure that supports how the world’s capital is operated, governed, and allocated. You’ve spent the last few years in banking, consulting, or investing, learning how investment firms evaluate opportunities and make decisions. At Hanover Park, you’ll put that experience to work building a business.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Build our next stage of growth. Work directly with the CEO to decide which customers we pursue, how we reach them, and how we price and package our offering. Turn market research into decisions, then test those decisions in customer conversations.

 - Run the end to end process. Own the path from market opportunity to lasting customer partnership. Identify where to focus, build relationships, understand customer needs, shape the right engagement, and guide decisions through implementation. Develop new opportunities while making the most of existing demand.

 - Translate customer needs into product decisions. Bring what you learn from CFOs to product, engineering, and deployments. Help distinguish what wins one deal from what makes the business stronger across customers.

 - Open new markets. Develop a thesis on a customer segment, identify the right firms and decision-makers, and figure out how to earn their business.

 - Solve consequential business problems. Take ownership of a defined problem beyond your deals, whether that’s improving pricing, refining a deployment handoff, or helping hire the next member of the team.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to four years in investment banking, investing, or consulting, with meaningful exposure to private markets or investment firms.

 - An understanding of fund operations. You know what capital calls, distributions, waterfalls, NAV, and LP reporting mean, and why they matter to a CFO. You don’t need to have owned the accounting.

 - Strong judgment and attention to detail. You ask good questions, write clearly, check your numbers, and prepare thoroughly.

ABOUT HARPER

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage for small businesses. We built our own software for nearly every step, so our people spend their time where trust matters. We use AI to earn that trust.

Our AI writes notes, enriches leads, and routes work all day. You own the revenue system underneath it, and you make it tell the truth.

Two dashboards disagree about last week's close rate. You trace it to a stage that changed without its owner changing, fix the definition, add a test to the routing rule, and publish one number. The next Monday the forecast moves, and this time everyone can see why.

At most growing companies, RevOps gets pieced together: a routing rule here, a dashboard there. That got Harper to roughly 100x growth. It will not get us through the next stage across three offices.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the funnel definitions. Give every revenue stage one meaning, one entry and exit rule, one source, and one owner.

 - Own CRM behavior and routing. Every field, automation, and routing change has a test case, an owner, an effective date, and a rollback path.

 - Own the forecast. Publish the method, inputs, and assumptions, and reconcile the variance to booked revenue every cycle.

 - Instrument revenue. Make demand, contact, intake, quote, close, bind, and booked revenue reconcile to their source records.

 - Turn analysis into action. Find where volume, conversion, speed, or handoffs break, and give the fix a named owner.

 - Automate with controls. Use AI for enrichment, notes, tasks, and reporting only when the source and correction path stay visible.


WHAT YOU NEED

 - You have owned revenue, sales, or growth operations at a fast-growing company. This is the background we have been missing.

 - You understand CRM architecture, lifecycle stages, routing, attribution, and forecasting from the inside, and you can write SQL or test a claim in the data yourself.

 - You want to be measured on booked revenue and conversion, not dashboard activity, and you say so plainly when a change did not work.

Insurance experience helps, and it is not required. If you meet most of this, apply.


THE REALITY: READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This job starts as archaeology. You will find every definition that drifted and every automation nobody owns, and fix them while revenue keeps moving. There is no pause button and no clean handoff.

This is not the seat if you want to administer a CRM without owning the outcome, if you produce reports but not recommendations, if you want to run sales management or marketing creative, or if you need a remote or hybrid schedule.

It is the seat if building one revenue system everyone trusts sounds like the work you want.




HOW WE HIRE

 1. A 30-minute team call on Zoom.

 2. An office session of about two hours, meeting more of the team and working a real problem with us.

 3. A super day in the office, showing how you operate in real time. We decide after this.


THE BASICS

 - Pay: $160,000 to $210,000 base. Bonus and equity eligible.

 - Where: On-site, five days a week, in the room with the team, with travel to Atlanta and New York. San Francisco at 425 Market Street.

 - Hours:  5am to 7pm PT, Monday through Friday.

 - License: None required.

 - Benefits: Health, dental, and vision. San Francisco adds three meals a day in the office, commuter benefits, and a gym membership.


HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short note about a funnel or CRM problem that looked like a data issue but was really an operating issue. Tell us how you proved it, what you changed, and the result.


Harper is an equal opportunity employer.

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Anthropic's go-to-market organization is growing quickly, and every territory and account assignment has to land correctly for the field to do its best work. The Strategic Planning team sits at the center of that. We work across field Strategy & Operations, Finance, Systems, Data, Incentives and People to help leadership decide where to invest, turn those decisions into a plan, and keep the plan working all year.
 This role owns the account side of GTM planning, who covers what: territories, the data enrichment and system requirements behind them, rules of engagement (RoEs), and the account moves that follow during the year.
 You'll join a small, high-leverage team and take end-to-end ownership of that scope. That starts with understanding the plan: how coverage, territories and account data fit together, what assumptions sit underneath them, and what happens downstream when one changes.  Location: Remote (US) 
 About Us 
 Atari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises.
 The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.
 Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, France, Germany, Sweden, and India.our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the financial health of our diverse business operations.
 About the Role 
 As an Associate Producer working on Atari’s rapidly growing publishing label of projects, you will act as both a publishing producer and junior release manager supporting the launch of a large number of small titles across PC and consoles throughout the year. You’ll be responsible for tracking key project milestones, working closely with license partners for approvals, and managing the setup and eventual release of projects through first-party management systems.
 What You’ll Do 
- Oversee multiple projects and their backlogs from start to finish, working within detailed production schedules, fast submission cycles, and tight approval deadlines.
- Facilitate cross-departmental collaboration to acquire necessary assets and communicate project updates effectively.
- Serve as a point of contact for all publishing-related matters while working closely with development team project leads. 
- Manage project timelines, roadmaps, and budgets for concurrent projects.
- Establish and maintain production workbacks, milestones, and approval processes.
- Ensure the quality of all projects and coordinate publishing services such as QA and localization.
- Coordinate IP collaborations and approvals with external IP owners.
- Set up backend systems for projects and storefronts, user onboarding, and launch.
- Create first-party submission schedules and handle platform submissions, securing waivers, reporting bugs, and managing communication with first-party vendors.
- Coordinate with internal departments for assets, pricing, metadata, and key management/distribution, and manage external localization teams for store pages.
 What We’re Looking For 
- At least two years of experience in PC and console game production.
- A track record of shipping at least two titles on different platforms within the last three years.
- Demonstrated ability to produce, manage, and drive projects across multiple departments.
- Knowledge of first-party submission platforms and forms.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Strong presentation, reporting, and organizational abilities.
- Experience working on multiple projects simultaneously.
- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bring solutions to the table and anticipate blockers.
- Alignment with Atari’s core values: long-term thinking, growth mindset, passion & excellence, and drive.
 Bonus Points 
- Familiarity with legacy games and platforms.
- Familiarity working with task-tracking systems like Asana.
- Experience working as a release manager for PC and console games.
- Experience working with first-party backend platforms such as NDP, Playstation Partners, Partner Center, and Steamworks.
- Experience with emulation technology.
- Proficiency in Google Workspace tools.
- Experience using Miro for visual workflows.
- Knowledge in FTP clients.
 Target Salary: $75k - $90k

COMPANY OVERVIEW 
 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
 TEAM OVERVIEW 
KKR’s Credit Solutions team sits within the firm’s Credit & Markets platform and combines principal credit investing with capital markets capabilities to deliver tailored financing solutions to upper middle market and large companies across a broad range of industries. The team manages $135Bn of assets under management within its private credit strategy and invests primarily in senior secured unitranche loans as well as flexibly across other parts of the capital structure, including junior capital, mezzanine, and preferred equity.
 The Credit Solutions team works closely with KKR Capital Markets and other KKR investment teams, enabling a coordinated approach to sourcing, underwriting, structuring, and executing transactions across public and private markets. The team is involved throughout the full investment lifecycle, including diligence, investment committee approval, execution, portfolio management, and exit activity, and has completed approximately 300 global direct lending transactions since inception in 2005.
 POSITION SUMMARY 
KKR is looking for an Analyst/Associate to join the Credit Solutions Group and work closely with sponsors to source and underwrite private credit investment opportunities.
 Opportunity highlights include:
 •    Flat and lean team, less than 30 investment professionals based primarily in New York, which provides strong exposure to senior team members
•    PE-style diligence with high level of deal velocity across a large breadth of industries and types of investments as compared to other Associate roles
•    Completed ~300 global direct lending transactions since inception in 2005
•    Upon completion of investments, deal teams continue to work closely with sponsors to monitor company performance and evaluate add-on transactions
•    Commingled direct lending and private opportunistic credit investment vehicles, as well as a robust capital markets team, allow for great degree of flexibility
•    Differentiated ownership of workstreams at the Analyst / Associate level with limited oversight. Opportunity to “think like an investor.”
 QUALIFICATIONS 
The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of full-time work experience in investment banking, credit, lending, or other relevant buyside roles. The team will consider candidates from a variety of groups, but Leveraged Finance, Financial Sponsors or Restructuring exposure would be beneficial.
 CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS 
•    Technical skills with an ability to demonstrate good investment instincts, analytical capabilities, and finance, accounting and modeling skills

About us: 
 Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.
 Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 
 We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.
 Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.
 About the role: 
 Branch's fraud and disputes customers now reach us around the clock. Our BPO partner handles inbound phone and chat 24/7 for fraud claims, dispute intake, account unlocks, and account takeover (ATO) contacts, backed by a seven-day back office. That front office is where most customers first tell us something went wrong, and where a bad actor is most likely to try to talk their way into an account.
 As Risk and Recovery Contact Operations Manager, you own the inbound phone and chat operation for Risk & Recovery. You know its health hour by hour, you are accountable for its performance, and when someone asks how the 24/7 operation is running, you are the answer. The BPO executes the contacts. You own the procedures, the quality bar, the coverage, and the outcomes, regardless of who picks up the phone. Enterprise Systems owns the BPO contract, renewals, and contractual SLAs; you own the day-to-day operation.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. It is a focused version of a full BPO support manager role: one vendor, Risk & Recovery lines of business only, no internal team to manage. It suits someone with BPO contact center experience who also understands fraud, disputes, or risk, and who wants to own an operation rather than a queue.
 Responsibilities:
Run the 24/7 Office: 
- Own the daily health of R&R inbound phone and chat: volume, speed to answer, abandonment, handle time, first-contact resolution, transfers, and misroutes
- Lead a daily stand-up with BPO operations leads to review prior-day performance and set the day's priorities
- Watch intraday coverage and act on gaps before they become a backlog or a missed SLA
- Drive resolution on the call. The initial target is resolving 50% of fraud contacts on the phone, without a hand-off to the back office
 Staffing/Coverage:
- Supply the R&R inputs the staffing model depends on: contact volume by line of business, work mix, handle-time assumptions, and arrival patterns
- Partner hands-on with Support's BPO Manager on forecasting and scheduling in Zendesk WFM; you own whether R&R coverage is right, they own the WFM tooling and the CX relationship

About Us
 Public is the world’s first agentic brokerage, combining a comprehensive multi-asset investing experience with all the advantages of AI Agents.
 Members can invest in stocks, options, bonds, crypto, and event contracts, and manage a variety of accounts including their personal brokerage, margin, retirement accounts, and business accounts—all in the same place.
 Since 2019, Public has raised $400 million. Investors include Accel, Tiger Global, Will Smith's Dreamers VC, The Chainsmokers' Mantis VC, as well as renowned figures in business and culture, like Maria Sharapova, Tony Hawk, and NYU Stern professor Scott Galloway.
 About the Role 
 As a key member of Public's data team, you will own the development and optimization of our semantic layer and the data models behind it. Working with stakeholders across product, marketing, finance, CX, and brokerage ops, you'll use SQL and dbt to build reliable pipelines, define the company's core metrics once, and make them usable by people and AI agents alike. Your work will directly shape how Public makes decisions, from daily business reporting to product experiments.
 This role is based in New York City and reports directly to the Director of Data.
 What You’ll Do 
- Build and maintain centralized company metrics and data models in dbt and our Omni semantic layer, so every team works from the same definitions
- Partner with product, finance, marketing, CX, and brokerage ops to turn business questions into well-modeled, self-serve data
- Work with frontend and backend engineers to define data contracts and event tracking, and model eventstream data from app, backend, and Braze sources
- Design and build Omni dashboards and reports for key metrics and KPIs
- Make our data AI-ready: curate models, descriptions, and topics so teams can get accurate answers through Claude and other AI agents
- Run analyses that improve product and business metrics, using visualization, experimentation, backtesting, and data science methods
- Participate in code reviews and give feedback to keep our codebase high-quality and maintainable
- Feed data-driven recommendations back to lifecycle marketing and backend systems through automated reverse ETL pipelines (Hightouch, Segment)
- Maintain, optimize, and improve Public's data infrastructure across dbt, Omni, Snowflake, Fivetran, Airflow, and Hightouch
 Experience 
- 3–5 years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or data analytics, preferably in finance, brokerage, or fintech
- Hands-on experience building production data models in dbt
- Familiarity with data modeling techniques such as Kimball dimensional modeling and star schemas
- Strong SQL and the ability to write efficient queries on a cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred; Redshift or BigQuery also relevant)
- Experience with Omni or other modern BI tools with a semantic layer (e.g. LookML)
- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor in your data work, such as writing and refactoring dbt models, debugging pipelines, and speeding up analysis
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
- Clear communicator who can present data-driven narratives in writing and in person
- Quick learner who can grasp the fundamentals of the business and the key drivers behind company metrics
- Investigative mindset; willing to think outside the box and contribute ideas across business functions
 Bonus Points 
- Interest in personal finance and investing
- Experience in a fast-paced startup, especially in fintech or consumer brands
- Experience with modern ingestion and orchestration tools (Fivetran, Airflow) and reverse ETL (Hightouch, Segment)
- Experience modeling product event data (Segment, Braze, or similar) and defining tracking plans or data contracts
- Experience building AI agents or tools on top of data (e.g. MCP servers, text-to-SQL)

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.
 Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.
 Overview 
 As a Client Strategy Associate , you keep the daily operations of assigned Managed Marketplaces clients running as they launch and grow on major U.S. marketplaces. Working alongside Technical Account Managers (TAMs), you monitor listing health, resolve listing errors, turn listing data into daily and monthly reports, and keep launches, client sessions, and change requests on track. You are the day-to-day link between the TAMs and Rithum’s managed services partner. You deliver accurate, on-time reports and raise issues, with a likely cause and owner, before they affect client sales. This role is designed as an entry point into Technical Account Management. With hands-on training from the TAM team and exposure to some of Rithum’s largest Managed Marketplaces clients, Client Strategy Associates build the skills to progress to Technical Account Manager and then Senior Technical Account Manager.
 At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.
 Responsibilities 
 Listing Health & Issue Resolution
- Monitor daily listing and publication status across assigned marketplaces and alert TAMs to drops, including the likely cause and owner.
- Resolve listing and publication errors in the Rithum platform, and escalate through Salesforce when needed.
- Update content, taxonomy, attributes, and pricing to bring new marketplaces to 90% publication within one month and sustain 97% or higher.
- Take products live within 3 business days of receiving complete data.
 Reporting & Client Readiness
- Build and deliver daily listing reports on time every business day.
- Compile monthly KPI scorecards and channel health checks, and submit them to TAMs for review.
- Prepare materials for weekly client sessions and for launch and optimization workshops, and support each launch through ramp-up and hypercare.
- Prepare assigned accounts for peak and holiday periods, including seasonal coverage for Cyber 5.
 Partner Coordination & Account Continuity
- Coordinate daily with Rithum’s managed services partner on assigned client work, and check its output against runbooks and client requirements before it reaches the client.
- Maintain runbooks, mapping documentation, and open-issue logs so any assigned account can be covered at any time.
- Cover day-to-day operations for assigned accounts when a TAM is out or transitioning, following documented runbooks.
- Log scope variations and change requests, and keep the risk and issue tracker and Salesforce cases current.
 AI-Enabled Ways of Working
- Use AI tools consistently for listing analysis, daily and monthly reporting, and documentation, and verify output against source data before it reaches anyone else.
- Flag cases where AI output was wrong, and suggest repeatable listing and reporting tasks to automate or standardize.
 Qualifications  
 Minimum Qualifications  
- 1+ years of experience in e-commerce operations, client support, or data operations (internships count).
- Experience using Exc

At #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create. With our proprietary technology and an unwavering commitment to trust and transparency, we’re revolutionizing the way brands and creators come together to make magic. Rated #1 for customer support and managed services, #paid is leading the creator marketing space. Through innovative technology and a team of ambitious humans, we're transforming the future of the creator economy.


As an Associate Client Partner, you'll be the first responder on our largest client relationships and a trusted partner to our Senior Client Partners. Build What Matters at Model N 
At Model N, we help life sciences companies solve complex revenue challenges so they can operate smarter and bring important innovations to market faster. We are looking for people who like practical problem solving, cross-functional work, and seeing the impact of what they build. 
If you are energized by leading a team that turns complex Medicaid rebate requirements into accurate, on-time results for our clients, this could be a great fit. 
About the Role 
We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Revenue Mgmt Services to join our Revenue Management Services team. In this role, you will lead our Medicaid operations team and serve as the go-to subject matter expert on Medicaid processing and contracting. You will work closely with clients, product teams, and GP Pricing and GTN colleagues to help Model N deliver accurate, compliant rebate management at scale. You will drive best in class processes, efficiencies and ensure client retention and partnership. 
This role matters because Medicaid rebates carry real financial and compliance weight for our clients. The accuracy and timeliness of this work affects their savings and their standing with state agencies. 
Key Responsibilities 
Set and lead department standard operating procedures and business processes, ensuring department compliance 
Direct the review and approval of Medicaid rebate deliverables so clients receive accurate, compliant results that meet government requirements and SLAs.

Lead and develop a high-performing Medicaid operations team, building capability through clear goals, regular feedback, and development plans. 
Drive rebate savings by validating claims-level detail and partnering with states to resolve disputes. 
Partner with product teams on system enhancements and AI and automation, and lead the change management that puts new capabilities into daily work. 
What Success Looks Like 
First 90 days: 
Build a clear picture of the Medicaid operations team, its client portfolio, and current service levels. 
Learn the Model N rebate systems and the compliance requirements behind each deliverable. 
Establish working relationships with key clients and with GP Pricing and GTN partners. 
Identify the most important process or quality gaps and agree on a first improvement plan. 
First 6–12 months: 
Deliver client work on time and accurately, with consistent SLA performance. 
Launch at least one process or automation improvement that measurably reduces rework or cycle time. 
Grow team members through regular feedback and clear development plans. 
Be the Medicaid expert that clients and internal partners rely on. 
How You Will Grow and Make an Impact 
At Model N, our competency model helps us talk about growth, impact, and how work gets done. 
People Leadership – You actively develop your Medicaid operations team and build capability for future leaders. 
Problem-Solving Leadership – You resolve complex claims and contract issues that span multiple groups, and scale the practices that work. 
Thought Leadership – You connect regulatory and client insights across teams and influence priorities with a forward-looking view of Medicaid rebates. 
Entrepreneurial Leadership – You lead change in how Medicaid work gets done and turn improvement ideas into results. 
Operational Leadership – You optimize team operations and improve rebate delivery performance at scale. 
AI Leadership – You bring AI into team workflows and scale the uses that improve accuracy and speed.

Makpar is a comprehensive professional and technical solutions provider for the Federal government. We combine functional and technical expertise in cloud engineering, data management, cybersecurity and emerging technologies to deliver mission success. We build the right IT solution for government clients by partnering with them to understand their WHAT, WHY, and HOW. Using our signature consulting methodology that we call “The Makpar Way,” we help agencies navigate the ongoing changes in the Federal technology landscape. We succeed where others fail because of our connected and engaged workforce are dedicated to delivering success for our clients and the American people. 

Our Mission: We solve complex problems for the Federal government to accelerate access to citizen services.

When it comes to excellence, we deliver. Learn more about our employer brand at makpar.com/careers.



The Position:
 
Makpar has an exciting opportunity for a Service Center Analyst to join our growing team. This role is largely responsible for providing remote customer support for Federal Government systems and applications. Support for these systems is primarily provided over the phone and through electronic communications such as email and fax. We are looking for a highly competent, customer service-oriented, and motivated individual to fill this role. The ideal candidate must reside within an hour’s commute of Washington, D.C or Denver, CO.


Role Specific Duties:
- Handling incoming phone requests from customers
- Handling incoming electronic requests (Chat, Email, and Fax) from customers
- Creating, tracking, and resolving Human Resources (HR) application incidents and service requests.
- Fulfilling customer requests in a timely manner to meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Researching customer requests to ensure accurate information and resolutions are provided
- Escalating customer requests that cannot be handled at the Service Center to the appropriate support team
- Using customer service skills to clarify customer issues and requests to ensure proper resolution or escalation
- Creating, updating, and retiring service center knowledge documentation
- Attend and participate in team meetings to surface and discuss process improvements and service offering changes

Required Qualifications:
- High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
- Must reside within an hour’s commute of Washington, D.C or Denver, CO.
- Minimum of 2 years in customer service; experience in a service desk or call center environment preferred.
- HDI Analyst Certification (e.g., CSA, SCA, DST) required within 90 business days of hire.
- Strong critical thinking abilities.
- Excellent active listening and communication skills.
- Experience with ticketing applications (Jira, ServiceNow, or other customer service tracking systems).
- Familiarity with BMC Remedy Service Management preferred.
- Experience providing technical support for any Human Resource based IT applications preferred.
- This role requires a clearance. Candidates must be a US Citizen or a Legal Permanent Resident (Green Card status) for a minumum of 3 years to obtain.

Benefits:

At Makpar Corporation we understand that we all need to balance work and life – that is why we have a great benefits package, excellent training and career development opportunities, flexible work schedules along with a generous compensation package. At Makpar, we believe in keeping our employees happy, healthy and engaged. We pride ourselves in providing outstanding benefits, creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, collaborate, and be inquisitive in order to achieve goals.

Start your career today and be a part of something meaningful!

Makpar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.


About the Role
We internalized our accounting function in February 2025 and have since built a solid Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) foundation from Paris. The next step is to bring AR and revenue accounting to public-company standards, at scale, and closer to our fastest-growing market. This is why we are creating a Revenue Accounting & Order-to-Cash role in the US.
 You will own the full AR and revenue accounting cycle for the Group, manage our AR Accountant based in Paris, and report to our Head of Accounting, Tax & Consolidation, also in Paris. 
 Designed for an experienced AR or order-to-cash manager who already owns revenue recognition and wants to grow into a Group revenue leadership role.
 This role can be based in our New York City office on a hybrid schedule, or fully remote within the Eastern Time zone.

What You'll Do
You'll own Quote-to-Cash and revenue accounting for a fast-growing, multi-entity group, one function, one owner, full accountability. Working remotely with a small team across Paris and the US, you'll shape how revenue is recognized, closed, collected and reported as we build toward our next stage, and use Pigment, NetSuite and AI to make that engine faster and more automated than most finance teams get to.
- 
 Own Quote-to-Cash for the Group. From contract review and invoicing to collections and close, you run the full cycle and are accountable for its accuracy, speed and cash impact.
- 
 Be the revenue recognition authority. IFRS 15 (ASC 606 equivalent) end to end: performance obligations, SSP, multi-element and multi-year deals, modifications, and the technical memos that back our numbers.
- 
 Run a fast, reliable revenue close. Revenue recognition, deferred revenue, contract assets, ARR-to-revenue bridge, and variance analysis with FP&A — numbers leadership can act on.
- 
 Turn receivables into cash, globally. Own DSO, aging, dunning, credit policy and disputes; manage escalations and external recovery partners.
- 
 Automate the function. Design and document controls, eliminate manual steps, and use Pigment-native workflows and AI to shrink close and reconciliation effort, with NetSuite and Salesforce as systems of record.
- 
 Shape deals before they're signed. Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal and RevOps on structuring, billing terms and pricing; act as accounting lead for our US teams and customers, including sales tax alongside our Head of Tax.

Who You Are
- 
 8+ years in accounting or order-to-cash, including 3+ years leading AR, billing or revenue operations in B2B SaaS or a high-growth scale-up
- 
 Deep, hands-on ASC 606 expertise: you've owned revenue recognition for real contracts, defended positions with auditors, and can explain them to non-accountant

 Under the assignment of the Construction Manager, the position is responsible for several new-store projects simultaneously, following the principle of “one project owner per store.” The role takes over approved internal layouts and technical requirements; identifies and coordinates local licensed drafters/architects, renovation teams, signage teams, and other vendors; and continuously follows up on landlord and government approvals, construction, costs, delivery of shelving/equipment, inspections, and handover. From project assignment through completion of construction, corrective work, documentation, payments, and outstanding items, the role bears direct execution responsibility for the schedule, quality, communication, and issue resolution of each assigned store. 
 Job Responsibilities 
 1.Project Intake and Execution Planning 
 a. Receive store project assignments from the Construction Manager, together with approved internal layouts, shelving/equipment requirements, opening targets, budgets, and project responsibility boundaries. 
 b. Verify the landlord’s base drawings, site dimensions, Work Letter, delivery conditions, contacts, utility information, construction restrictions, and local government requirements. Promptly report unclear documentation or discrepancies between documents and actual site conditions. 
 c. Develop a detailed execution plan and task list for each assigned store, identifying milestones for design and permitting, vendor selection, construction, signage, shelving delivery, inspections, acceptance, and handover.

 2.Sourcing and Approval of Renovation, Signage, and Other Vendors 
 a. Identify local general contractors, specialty contractors, signage companies, and related vendors with appropriate licenses, insurance, and demonstrated ability to perform; arrange site visits and communicate project requirements. 
 b. Collect quotations, scopes of work, materials, schedules, payment milestones, warranties, and past project examples; prepare price comparisons and vendor recommendations and submit them for approval in accordance with company procedures. 
 c. Assist with contracts/purchase orders (POs), insurance, permits, landlord submissions, and vendor onboarding. No work may begin, orders may be placed, or commercial terms changed before the required approval is obtained. 
 d. Maintain vendor contacts, delivery milestones, and risk lists. Promptly recommend replacement when a vendor demonstrates insufficient capability, abnormal pricing, or performance risks.

 4. Cost, Payment Requests, Change Orders, and Shelving Delivery Coordination 
 a. Verify vendor contracts, purchase orders, invoices, construction progress, material arrivals, and inspection/acceptance status; confirm payment milestones and compile complete payment request documentation, including vendor tax forms (W-9), for the Construction Manager’s review. \

The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) protects public health and the environment by supplying clean drinking water, collecting and treating wastewater, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. The responsibility of maintaining these vast networks falls under the Department of Environmental Protection’s Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations (BWSO). This involves the planning and project development for all new sewer systems, water mains, and all other related infrastructure within New York City. About LawnStarter 
 LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there.
 About the Team 
 We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work.
 Requirements 
 The Role 
 As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training.
 You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach.
 This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight.
 What You'll Own 
- Modeling & Analysis:  A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R.
- Reporting:  A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on.
- Analytics Engineering:  Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must.
 Problems to Solve 
 Metrics nobody fully trusts.  Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job.
 Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything.  A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL.
 Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch.  If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck.
 A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal.  Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality.
 What Success Looks Like (Year 1) 
- The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard.
- Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull.
- You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered.
- The datasets and models you've built in dbt

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.
 Job Overview:  
 Humanitarian needs are rising while funding falls. We believe AI, used well, can help close that gap. So we are transforming how the IRC works. We are giving staff across the organization AI tools and training. We are reshaping core work like supply chain and finance. And we are reinventing how we reach people in crisis, from detecting health threats earlier to putting an AI coach in the hands of teachers and parents.
 We are hiring a Manager, AI Transformation Portfolio to join the small central team that keeps this work coordinated, visible, and on track. You will track progress across a portfolio of about 40 projects, spot risks early, and make sure senior leaders have what they need to decide. You will coordinate internal communications on the transformation. And you will work directly with the IRC’s AI Executive Lead, its Chief Information Officer, and members of the Executive Board, the IRC’s senior-most leaders.
 This is a 12-month role with a clear mission: help the IRC move its AI priorities from pilot to scale. We are building the structure as we go. You will bring order to ambiguity, hold owners to their commitments, and build practices that departments can run on their own as the work matures. This is not a technical role, but you will use Claude and other AI tools every day to do it well. 
 What Success Looks Like in 12 Months:  
 This role will support each of AI Transformation Strategy’s 12 month Key Performance Indicators:
- A meaningful number of priority projects have moved from pilot to scale, with lessons captured and reused across the IRC. à You will help spot and share reusable insights and building blocks across projects. 
- The Executive Board has a clear, current picture of AI spend, use cases deployed, and impact, without a heavy reporting burden on project teams. à You will refine and maintain the high efficiency, AI-enabled system that enables this visibility.  
- Enterprise-wide risks have been identified and managed early. à You will spot and escalate key risks. 
- Departments are advancing their own AI priorities with minimal duplication. à You will help automate and simplify the tracking system so that, as directed by the Director, it can extend to projects outside the starting priority set without adding staff time for project teams. 
 Additionally, you will help build broader organizational awareness for the IRC’s transformation agenda down to the impacts and learnings of specific projects. 
 Major Responsibilities: 
 Portfolio Management (approximately 60%) 
- Prepare Executive Board communications and decision-making materials. Prepare standing monthly and quarterly reporting for senior leaders, including drafting updates and keeping the transformation scorecard current. Identify the need for ad hoc meetings and prepare their agendas and materials.
- Proactively understand status, blockers, and spend across AI priority projects to support progress against KPIs. Strategically escalate issues, opportunities, and risks to Director. 
- Run the weekly orchestration team meeting. Build the agenda from the tracker and other intelligence. Keep time focused on the highest-priority needs. Assign action i

Join a quantitative team supporting a large municipal bond market-making desk. We work alongside traders across electronic and voice trading, bond origination, specialized lending, and bespoke derivative products.
 Our team uses mathematics, statistics, machine learning, and software to solve practical trading problems. We analyze trading strategies, build electronic trading algorithms, model the financial risks associated with the desk’s inventory, and conduct detailed analysis of trading profits and losses.
 Municipal markets offer particularly interesting quantitative challenges. Many securities trade infrequently, bonds differ across numerous structural features, and available market data can be incomplete. We develop mathematical models that connect observable market variables to bond prices, helping the trading desk estimate value, identify relative-value opportunities, manage risk, and make better trading decisions.
 The Role 
 As a Quantitative Strategist, you will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers. You will use data and statistical analysis to identify potential trading strategies, assist with complex trades and hedging decisions, and improve the models and systems used to price securities and monitor risk.
 You will also help organize and maintain the team’s quantitative research environment, including its modeling software, research archive, Python packages, Linux environment, containers and testing. The role includes both immediate desk-facing analysis and longer-term research into trading strategies and market behavior.
 Responsibilities 
- Research and test quantitative trading strategies.
- Help traders evaluate complex transactions, hedge selection, position sizing, and execution timing.
- Develop pricing and risk models for municipal bonds, bond derivatives, and related products.
- Analyze inventory risk, trading activity, and profit-and-loss performance.
- Apply statistics and machine learning to trading, pricing, and risk-management problems.
- Help move machine-learning and AI models into production.
- Organize and maintain quantitative models, research code, and development environments.
- Communicate analytical findings clearly to traders and other stakeholders.
 Qualifications 
- Bachelor’s degree in mathematics.
- Masters degree in STEM, preferably Applied Math, MFE, Operations Research, Statistics, Physics, Engineering. 
- Strong knowledge of probability, statistics, numerical methods, and mathematical modeling.
- Good programming skills, preferably in Python.
- Familiarity with, or an interest in learning, Linux, Git, package management, containers, pandas, and NumPy.
- Strong interest in trading and financial markets.
- The ability to take ownership of software, models, and research processes.
- Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
- A collaborative personality and an interest in working closely with PEOPLE on  trading desk.
- Ability to stay calm under pressure
- Positive, can do, extrovert personality
- Experience with fixed income, derivatives, bond mathematics, JavaScript, kdb+/q, machine learning, or production model deployment is helpful but not required.
- Recent graduates and candidates with up to three years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Prior municipal bond experience is not required.

 This role is to be based near either New York City or Philadelphia 
 About us:    
 We drive intelligent growth for ambitious businesses and leading brands.   
 Customer understanding is more potent and drives greater value when insights go to work directly within marketing and experience priorities. To give our clients that advantage, we put an insights-driven operating system at the core of our design, go-to-market and digital experience solutions.    
 Material clients make smarter growth choices because they can see clearly how and when to take the shots that count. Together, we connect consumer intelligence with customer demand generation to build lasting, profitable relationships.  
 About the Sr. Manager, Social Strategy   
 We are seeking a Sr. Manager, Social Strategy   to lead the development of audience-centric social strategies that help brands earn relevance, build community, and drive business impact in an increasingly connected and culture-driven landscape.  
 In this role, you will bring deep expertise across social platforms, audience behavior, content strategy, and cultural intelligence to uncover opportunities for brands to show up in meaningful and authentic ways. You understand that effective social strategy lives at the intersection of consumer insights, brand values, platform dynamics, and culture. By connecting these elements, you will help brands create content ecosystems that resonate with audiences, inspire engagement, and strengthen long-term brand affinity.  
 As a core member of the team, you will partner closely with Creative, Insights, Analytics, Media, and Client Services to translate audience needs, emerging trends, and social behaviors into actionable strategic recommendations. You are equal parts strategist, storyteller, and trusted advisor, with a passion for helping brands navigate the evolving social landscape and identify the conversations, communities, and cultural moments that matter most.  
 The ideal candidate brings a strong point of view on how social can drive brand growth through purposeful content, community engagement, creator and influencer ecosystems, and culturally relevant storytelling. They are energized by turning insights into strategic frameworks that help brands build deeper connections with people, earn attention in crowded feeds, and create lasting relevance beyond individual campaigns.  
 Key Responsibilities    
- Executive Client Leadership & Presentation:  Act as the primary strategic client lead, driving client relationship growth and presenting high-impact decks directly to Director, VP, and executive-level client stakeholders.  
- Social-First Strategy : Develop social-first strategic frameworks grounded in audience insights, cultural relevance, and brand positioning. Define how brands can authentically participate in conversations, communities, and moments that matter, establishing a clear role for social in driving audience engagement and brand growth.  
- Audience & Content Ecosystem Mapping:  Identify audience motivations, behaviors, and unmet needs to develop platform-specific content strategies. Define audience segments, content pillars, engagement approaches, and creator opportunities that build relevance and foster ongoing community participation  
- Insight & Trend Translation:  Synthesize social listening, consumer research, performance data, and emerging cultural trends to uncover actionable opportunities for brands. Translate insights into strategic recommendations that strengthen audience connection, cultural resonance, and market differentiation.  
- Strategic Narrative & Storytelling:  Distill raw data, research, and channel mechanics into executive-ready narratives and actionable business recommendations.   
- Measurement & Optimization:  Establish social KPIs and measurement frameworks that evaluate channel performance and quantify social's contribution to broader marketing and business outcome

 Bullish is an institutionally focused global digital asset platform that provides market infrastructure and information services. These include:   Bullish   Exchange   – a regulated and institutionally focused digital assets spot and derivatives exchange, integrating a high-performance central limit order book matching engine with automated market making to provide deep and predictable liquidity. Bullish Exchange is regulated in Germany, Hong Kong, and Gibraltar.   CoinDesk   Indices   – a collection of tradable proprietary and single-asset benchmarks and indices that track the performance of digital assets for global institutions in the digital assets and traditional finance industries.   CoinDesk   Data   - a broad suite of digital assets market data and analytics, providing real-time insights into prices, trends, and market dynamics.   CoinDesk   Insights   – a digital asset media and events provider and operator of   Coindesk.com , a digital media platform that covers news and insights about digital assets, the underlying markets, policy, and blockchain technology. 
 Reports to: 
Head of Exchange and Custody Operations 
 Position Overview 
We’re seeking an Exchange Operations Specialist to join our team and drive the future of digital asset trading. You'll be at the forefront of Bullish operations, ensuring the seamless and secure functioning of our NYSE-listed exchange. If you're ready to take on an exciting operations role at the intersection of capital markets and cutting-edge financial
technology, we want to hear from you.

- Exchange and Client Excellence: You will fine-tune the platform to make sure trading is fast and reliable, providing high-quality support for our institutional clients. By keeping the trading environment top-notch, you establish the trust from clients and grow our business.
- Trading Algorithm & Execution Support: Engineering low-latency "algorithmic trading paths", scaling infrastructure to handle millions of transactions during market spikes, ensuring the trading algorithm can recover rapidly, and implementing security measures to detect unusual trade bursts.
- Be the Bridge Between Trading and Tech: Serve as a critical link between our sales teams, institutional clients, and technology organization. You will collaborate with Product and Engineering to support new products and features, ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into the live trading environment.
- Drive Strategic Optimization: This isn't just about keeping the lights on. We want you to constantly hunt for opportunities to improve and automate. You will lead projects to enhance client workflows and operational processes, directly contributing to platform efficiency, risk reduction, and our ability to scale.
- Shape Business Strategy with Data: Build and maintain powerful dashboards and reports that correlate deep technical metrics with key business KPIs. Your insights will empower our executive team to make data-driven strategic decisions.
- Uphold Market Integrity: Work in close partnership with our Finance, Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams to navigate the complex regulatory landscape of digital assets, ensuring a robust governance structure is maintained across all exchange activities.
 Experience & Qualifications: 
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Technology or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant experience with 2+ years in a trading operations, or trade support management role within digital assets, FinTech, or electronic trading.
- You have a strong background and deep understanding of trading, market structure, and the full order lifecycle.
- You are technically proficient and have hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting complex electronic trading systems running in the cloud. You are comfortable diving into system logs, diagnosing issues, and working with engineers to resolve them
- Proficient in Linux/Unix command-line environments and Bash scripti

Reporting to the Managing Director, Portfolio Management responsible for leading the Funds, the Analyst will be pivotal in helping implement and execute the investment strategy for the Fund, including portfolio construction, market and asset selection, financing, and making investment recommendations. The Analyst will also work closely with the alternatives sector teams, which includes acquisitions, asset management, development, and capital markets, as well as the distribution, product, research, finance, and marketing teams.   
 The Analyst’s primary responsibilities will be (i) extensive financial analysis (i.e. fund-level and property-level financial modeling, property valuation analyses, fund performance and benchmark analyses), (ii) investor reporting and presentations, and (iii) prospective investor marketing and due diligence.  The Analyst will also be instrumental in assisting in executing the capital raising strategy for the Fund in partnership with the distribution team.  Additionally, the Analyst will be an ambassador for the Funds and sectors at conferences and networking events on a national basis.

- Support the Fund’s objective of generating and sustaining outperformance by assisting in implementing and executing the Funds’ investment strategies

- Think critically about the risks and varying components of investments and the effect on overall Fund dynamics and composition

- Assist in creating, maintaining, and presenting Fund investment overview presentations

- Support fundraising and investor relations efforts including: setting and executing capital raising strategy, annual investor conference, advisory committee meetings, DDQ and RFP review, fulfilling investor requests, investor on-site meetings, and ongoing investor relations.
- Develop relationships with industry experts, strategic partners, investors, and fiduciaries by attending seminars, conferences, networking events to identify industry trends, potential capital sources, and promote the NRE brand.
